summary: Reproduced the user-reported bug: on plain Light theme the dashboard rendered the metal/steel nameplate (IndustrialBanner) instead of the transparent TOOLBOX VAULT wordmark image. Root cause: app/(tabs)/index.tsx has an early `if (skin === 'plain') return (...)` block (line ~613) that always rendered <IndustrialBanner title='DASHBOARD'/> — the `isPlainLight ? <TbvHeader/> : ...` check at line ~803 was in the dead code path after the plain return, so TbvHeader was NEVER mounted on plain Light. Applied a minimal patch in index.tsx so the plain branch renders <TbvHeader testID='tbv-header' showVersion={false}/> when isPlainLight, otherwise IndustrialBanner. Verified after expo restart: tbv-header is now in DOM on Light, screenshot shows the transparent wordmark, and the [TBVHEADER_DEBUG] console.warn fires with the exact expected values.
rca_of_issue: File /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/index.tsx contained two header-selection blocks. The first (inside `if (skin === 'plain')`) hard-coded <IndustrialBanner title='DASHBOARD'/> and unconditionally returned. The second (the industrial branch below) had the correct `isPlainLight ? <TbvHeader/> : isSteel ? ... : <IndustrialBanner/>` ladder, but that branch was unreachable for plain skins. Hence on appearance='light' (which sets skin='plain', appearance='light') the user saw the metal nameplate and the debug warn never fired (TbvHeader unmounted). Fix: replaced the static IndustrialBanner inside the plain branch with the same isPlainLight conditional.

ui_bugs.issue: Early `if (skin === 'plain')` return rendered <IndustrialBanner title='DASHBOARD'/> for BOTH plain-light and plain-dark, ignoring the intended TbvHeader logo image swap on Light. Fixed in place.

action_items: REVIEW the fix in /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/index.tsx ~lines 613-617 — the plain branch now mounts TbvHeader on Light. Passed showVersion={false} because the version label is positioned for the metal nameplate's bottom-right inset; if you want the version stamp on the light wordmark, add separate positioning in TbvHeader's useLightLogo branch.

OPTIONAL: remove the dead-code `isPlainLight ? <TbvHeader/>...` branch in the industrial code path below (it's now unreachable since plain skins return early). Keeping it doesn't hurt but is misleading.

critical_code_review_comments: Two parallel header-selection ladders in HomeScreen led to silent divergence. Consider extracting a single `renderHomeHeader()` helper used by both the plain and industrial returns so the conditions can't drift.
